data.name: Deeqat
data.gender_notes: Deeqat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is constantly seeking knowledge and truth from the divine sources. The name Deeqat carries the meaning “Seeker, explorer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Deeqat usually hope their child will grow to embody seeker, explorer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Deeqat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Seeker, explorer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Deeqat total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: دِیقَت
in_arabic.meaning: المتأمل والمتفكر الذي يبحث عن الحقيقة
in_arabic.long_meaning: دِیقَت هي كلمة عربية تعني التفكر والتدبر، وهي صفة للشخص الذي يبحث عن الحقيقة واليقين، ويتعمق في التفكير والنظر في الأشياء، ولهذه الكلمة أهمية كبيرة في الإسلام حيث يُشجع المسلمون على التفكر والتدبر في خلق الله وآيات القرآن

in_urdu.name: دِیقَت
in_urdu.meaning: غورو فکر اور تحقیق کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: دِیقَت ایک عربی لفظ ہے جس کا معنی ہے غورو فکر اور تحقیق کرنا، اور یہ وہ شخص ہوتا ہے جو حقیقت اور یقین کی तलاش میں ہوتا ہے، اور اس لفظ کی اہمیت اسلام میں بہت زیادہ ہے جہاں مسلمانوں کو غورو فکر اور تدبر کی ترغیب دی جاتی ہے

in_hindi.name: दीकत
in_hindi.long_meaning: दीकत एक अरबी शब्द है जिसका अर्थ है विचारशील और अनुसंधान करना, और यह वह व्यक्ति होता है जो सत्य और निश्चितता की खोज में होता है, और इस शब्द का महत्व इस्लाम में बहुत अधिक है जहां मुसलमानों को विचारशील और अनुसंधान करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: دېقَت
in_pashto.meaning: په حقیقت او یقین سره غور کوونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: دېقَت د عربي کلمې معنی دی چې د غور او غورچاښت په معنا دی، او دا هغه کس دی چې په حقیقت او یقین سره غور کوونکی دی، او دا کلمه د اسلام په معنا کې ډېر مهم دی چې پکې مسلمانان د غور او غورچاښت په لور هڅول کیږي

in_english.name: Deeqat
in_english.meaning: contemplative and thoughtful person seeking truth
in_english.long_meaning: Deeqat is an Arabic word meaning contemplative and thoughtful, referring to a person who seeks truth and certainty, and has great importance in Islam where Muslims are encouraged to contemplate and reflect on God's creation and Quranic verses

data.cultural_impact: The name "Deeqat" holds significant cultural influence in the Islamic society, as it represents a constant pursuit of knowledge and wisdom. In Islamic tradition, knowledge and education are highly valued and regarded as essential in leading a virtuous life. Thus, individuals bearing the name Deeqat are often seen as exemplars of this ideal, inspiring others to strive for knowledge and learning.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Deeqat" signifies an innate desire to connect with the divine and seek truth through spiritual practices and religious scholarship. This name is a reminder that the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom is not just an intellectual endeavor but an integral part of our spiritual journey towards self-realization and closeness to Allah. By embodying the qualities of a Deeqat, one is able to deepen their faith, enhance their understanding of Islamic teachings, and ultimately, strengthen their relationship with the Almighty.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Seeker, explorer" symbolizes One who is constantly seeking knowledge and truth from the divine sources.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Deeqat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of seeker, explorer.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Deeqat is the name of a famous mosque in Mogadishu, Somalia. The name Deeqat carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The mosque was a center of Islamic scholarship and learning during the Horn of Africa's medieval period.

trends: The name Deeqat is also used for various Islamic educational institutions and organizations.
It is also used as a given name for both males and females in the Somali community.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Deeqat remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
